Print a coverage object

Source: R/summary_functions.R
print.coverage.Rd

Print a coverage object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'coverage'
print(
  x,
  group = c("filename", "functions"),
  by = "line",
  n = Inf,
  missing = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

the coverage object to be printed

group

whether to group coverage by filename or function

by

whether to count coverage by line, expression or function

n

the maximum number of files or functions to print. They are sorted from least to most covered, so the least covered are shown first.

missing

whether to list the lines that were not run after each file or function that has any, as ranges such as missed 41-48, 112. Lines are joined into a range when only blank lines, comments and lines with only punctuation, such as closing braces, are between them. Code that was run, or that has no coverage data, such as the line a function is defined on, ends the range. Only used with by = "line", and ignored otherwise.

If branch coverage was measured (see covr.branch_coverage), the missed branches of each file or function are also listed, as missed branches 12 FALSE, 30 b: the line of the if or switch() and the label of the branch that was not taken. Only if and switch() calls that were evaluated are listed; the others are covered by the missed lines.

...

additional arguments ignored

Value

The coverage object (invisibly).

Branches

If branch coverage was measured (see covr.branch_coverage), the percentage of branches taken is also shown after the overall coverage, e.g. Coverage: 87.40% (branches 72.00%).

Examples

cov <- code_coverage(
  "f <- function(x) x + 1; g <- function(x) x - 1; h <- function(x) 0",
  "f(1)"
)
print(cov, group = "functions", n = 2)
#> Coverage: 0.00%
#> g: 0.00%
#> h: 0.00%
#> ... and 1 more function; use `print(x, n = Inf)` to show all

cov <- code_coverage(
  "f <- function(x) {\n  if (x) {\n    1\n\n    # no\n    2\n  }\n}",
  "f(FALSE)"
)
print(cov, missing = TRUE)
#> Coverage: 33.33%
#> /tmp/RtmpOeHbfo/source.R19674874b914: 33.33%  missed 3-6
